reviewer.identifier: Codex; Stage 3 whole-Model semantic review against clean Stage 2 commit 931f2bf4db037c6dcea66c2bc7931416e5cedacd. Inspected all 28 statements and seven arguments, current review packet, exact canonical propositions and quoted argument premises, summaries, explanations, sources, qualifiers, direct revision dependencies, and downstream uses. Constructed the two benefit inferences before the bounded empirical source check. Reviewed counterexamples of input without reorganization, reorganization without benefit, a favorable metric with relevant losses, local benefit without transfer, and functional benefit insufficient to warrant costs or risks, plus unclassifiable responses. Compared the final content diff and new files; the four changed existing canonical sentences are S-005, S-009, S-011, and S-012. Inspected unchanged schema, helpers, templates, identity, acknowledgment, and bare S-ID comments for adoption/confidence separation. Findings assess authoring consistency and entailment, not empirical confirmation; no separate agent or human approval was required.

src/content/model/arguments/actual-chiro.proposition: Deduction from exact S-022 value, S-024 reorganization definition, and S-011 actual joint causal improvement to mixed S-027 actual functional benefit.
src/content/model/arguments/actual-chiro.qualifiers: Some, input causation, neuromotor scope, context, and timescale are preserved. The same improving reorganization is valued; no nonoverlapping existential chain or broader transfer is introduced.
src/content/model/arguments/actual-chiro.evidenceSeparation: S-011 truth remains necessary and unresolved; the deduction does not establish soundness or improve confidence. Neither general adaptation nor defining success can replace that empirical premise.
src/content/model/arguments/actual-chiro.alignment: Checked all four quoted canonical sentences and the final three-premise wording. S-024 identifies a change, S-011 supplies its input-caused improvement, and S-022 supplies its value within exactly the same outcome scope.
src/content/model/arguments/actual-chiro.inferenceAndImpact: Existential instantiation followed by the universal value criterion entails S-027. The perturbation mechanism is unused and remains in S-028; no prevalence, prospective selection, durability, broader mediation, or warranted-care conclusion follows.

src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.proposition: S-005, S-006, S-009, and S-027 motivate S-014 prospective assessment; S-027 replaces the old combined S-011 benefit/mechanism premise.
src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.qualifiers: The some and can commitments do not identify a matching opportunity and effective input for this person. What if any and present actionability remain limiting conditions.
src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.evidenceSeparation: S-027 deduction does not confirm its empirical premise. Detection, causal outcome, prediction frequency, and the person-specific decision remain unresolved.
src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.alignment: Exact S-009 and S-027 quotations match canonical sentences. The explicit practical principle concerns whether to pursue the intervention after costs/risks/alternatives, rather than retrospective success classification.
src/content/model/arguments/assessment-a.inferenceAndImpact: Remains defeasible practical synthesis. Input without reorganization and reorganization without benefit remain counted; uncertain observations remain uncertain. A missed target is not absence and functional benefit alone is not sufficient warrant.

src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.proposition: Revised S-004, S-022, and S-005 to S-006 normative scope route separates open-ended framing, intrinsic functional value, and professional purpose.
src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.qualifiers: Beyond symptoms concerns a rationale for consideration, not actual opportunity, efficacy in every asymptomatic person, or a duty to act.
src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.evidenceSeparation: None of the framework/value premises supplies person-specific empirical support. Professional legitimacy and underlying value remain separate adopted judgments.
src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.alignment: S-005 is no longer cited as if its canonical sentence contains the benefit criterion. The explanation uses S-022 for that independent value and separates functional benefit from justified intervention.
src/content/model/arguments/functional-r.inferenceAndImpact: Remains defeasible because the route uses framework interpretation and a normative principle about independent aims. No direct transitive S-022 dependency is duplicated on S-006 merely because it is an argument premise.

src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.proposition: Unchanged S-001 and S-002 to S-003 methodological synthesis.
src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.qualifiers: Defeasible is retained; the premises motivate a revisable method rather than entail its unique necessity.
src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.evidenceSeparation: No empirical efficacy follows and no support is upgraded by adopting the method.
src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.alignment: Exact referenced framework propositions and their explanation remain aligned with the new value/empirical separation and downstream deductive labels.
src/content/model/arguments/methodologic.inferenceAndImpact: The argument stays separate from the methodological dependency graph and supplies no hidden premise to a benefit deduction.

src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.proposition: Retained S-014 and S-015 to S-016 practical route from a working hypothesis and conditional application to reassessment.
src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.qualifiers: Only delivered input triggers post-application comparison; later input remains conditional on justification. No guaranteed learning or successful adjustment is presupposed.
src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.evidenceSeparation: Informative reliable observations and decision thresholds remain empirical requirements. Before-and-after differences alone cannot establish causation, mechanism, durability, or broader benefit.
src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.alignment: Revised boundaries explicitly preserve no-reorganization, no-improvement, and uncertain outcomes, and distinguish functional benefit from intervention worth.
src/content/model/arguments/reassessment.inferenceAndImpact: Remains defeasible iterative testing with an explicit practical principle. No criterion definition validates reassessment or mandates continuing input, and no feedback loop is added to the dependency DAG.

src/content/model/arguments/regulatory-r.proposition: Retained six-premise biological rationale S-017, S-007, S-018, S-019, S-008, S-020 to S-004.
src/content/model/arguments/regulatory-r.qualifiers: Defeasibility and bounded open-ended scope remain. Continuing maintenance, limited information, and a locally best feasible response remain compatible with the premises.
src/content/model/arguments/regulatory-r.evidenceSeparation: Empirical confidence remains in the premise records. The new value criterion and downstream deductions provide no confirmation of the biological foundation or S-004.
src/content/model/arguments/regulatory-r.alignment: Boundary prose now locates comparative improvement in S-021, value in S-022, and professional purpose in S-005. It no longer repeats the old S-005 benefit-definition attribution.
src/content/model/arguments/regulatory-r.inferenceAndImpact: No benefit, opportunity, or chiropractic premise is added to the rationale. Failure of this route need not falsify S-004, and the original argument remains defeasible despite downstream deductions.

src/content/model/arguments/success-and-.proposition: Deduction from exact S-022 value, S-024 change/response definition, and S-025 success definition to S-026 scoped functional benefit.
src/content/model/arguments/success-and-.qualifiers: Universal conclusion applies only to successful adjustments in the same neuromotor scope, context, and timescale. No existential or all-input claim is introduced.
src/content/model/arguments/success-and-.evidenceSeparation: The inference is analytic given the value premise and remains true with no successes. Neither definition nor validity provides evidence of occurrence, frequency, or reliable detection.
src/content/model/arguments/success-and-.alignment: Checked all four quoted canonical sentences. S-024 explicitly classifies the response as a change; S-025 supplies improvement; S-022 values that same change. Local improvement does not become broader benefit or worthwhile intervention.
src/content/model/arguments/success-and-.inferenceAndImpact: Entailment holds with no extra biological or mechanistic premise: for any successful adjustment, the defined improving change falls under S-022. S-026 dependencies separately track definition and value without automatic copying of all premises.

src/content/model/statements/actual-chir.proposition: New mixed conclusion retains empirical input-caused reorganization and attributes a functional benefit using the adopted value criterion.
src/content/model/statements/actual-chir.qualifiers: Some asserts actual occurrence while preserving neuromotor scope, context, and timescale from S-011. It implies no prevalence, reliable prediction, or universal benefit.
src/content/model/statements/actual-chir.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence follows the empirical burden of S-011; adoption is explicit. The value premise and successful-adjustment definition supply no effect evidence.
src/content/model/statements/actual-chir.alignment: Summary, actual-benefit explanation, and whatWouldChange keep occurrence and evaluation distinct. Functional benefit is not the overall worth of an intervention, nor proof of perturbation, transfer, or durability.
src/content/model/statements/actual-chir.inferenceAndImpact: Empirical S-011 and normative S-022 dependencies support revision tracking separately from ARG-007 deduction. S-014 and ARG-002 now use this explicit benefit conclusion, retaining person-level and practical gaps.

src/content/model/statements/adjustment..proposition: New definition of adjustment as input-caused neuromotor reorganization, defining reorganization as changed organization of control or coordination.
src/content/model/statements/adjustment..qualifiers: Caused by is constitutive, not inferred merely from after. A change can be transient, neutral, or harmful; no arbitrary duration threshold is imposed.
src/content/model/statements/adjustment..evidenceSeparation: Not-applicable confidence is not evidence of occurrence or detection. Passive displacement, different testing conditions, measurement noise, and uncertain causal attribution do not establish an adjustment.
src/content/model/statements/adjustment..alignment: The body marks the Model-specific departure from procedure usage. No-reorganization inputs, nonbeneficial adjustments, adverse and uncertain responses remain in research accounting; ignorance is neither success nor failure.
src/content/model/statements/adjustment..inferenceAndImpact: Conceptual S-023 supplies the input meaning, with direct conceptual uses in S-011/S-025. Both deductions explicitly use the change classification, without inferring existence from the definition or duplicating its transitive dependencies.

src/content/model/statements/assessment..proposition: Retained prospective assessment strategy develops a working hypothesis about an actionable opportunity and what, if any, available input is most likely to help.
src/content/model/statements/assessment..qualifiers: Presently, working, and what if any constrain judgment under uncertainty; most likely is a selection question, not a claim that a validated predictor exists. No input remains admissible.
src/content/model/statements/assessment..evidenceSeparation: Strategy confidence remains unresolved. Detecting a response/opportunity, matching an input prospectively, and estimating success frequency require distinct validation; S-027 some cannot establish them for a person.
src/content/model/statements/assessment..alignment: The body specifies functional scope, comparison, timescale, competing demands, and costs/risks/alternatives. It preserves missed opportunities and distinguishes uncertainty from success or failure. Functional benefit alone need not justify an intervention.
src/content/model/statements/assessment..inferenceAndImpact: S-005/S-006/S-009 dependencies remain; practical S-011 is replaced by S-027 scoped benefit. ARG-002 remains defeasible with an explicit decision principle. S-015 and S-016 do not presuppose an adjustment from assessment.

src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.proposition: Actual empirical contribution of some chiropractic-produced neuromotor changes to improvement beyond the initially affected neuromotor scope.
src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.qualifiers: Some and contribution remain; broader is now explicitly relative to the initial neuromotor scope. Removing ambiguous net-positive does not remove relevant functional gains/losses, but disclaims any implication that all intervention costs are justified.
src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.evidenceSeparation: No claim-specific transfer evidence is documented; confidence remains unresolved. Revised whatWouldChange requires tests capable of detecting a qualifying causal contribution, not mere failure to find support.
src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.alignment: Statement, summary, explanation, and revision condition distinguish broader improvement from a local marker, mediator association, or worthwhile intervention. Local success without transfer is an explicit compatible counterexample.
src/content/model/statements/broader-fun.inferenceAndImpact: Conceptual outcome dependency moves from S-005 to S-021; empirical S-011 remains. S-013 is only related, because functional value and neural primacy do not establish one another. Neither new deduction concludes this broader transfer.

src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.proposition: Unchanged framework permission to consider a chiropractic rationale without symptoms, injury, disease, or identifiable pathology.
src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.qualifiers: Not necessary does not mean sufficient justification to act in their absence. The revised not sufficient indicators wording preserves the explanation that symptoms alone do not identify an input target.
src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.evidenceSeparation: No efficacy claim about asymptomatic people follows. The new value premise and professional aim remain separate from detectable opportunity and warranted action.
src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.alignment: Applied acts are now called inputs; adjustment names the organism response. Safety, comfort, missed opportunities, and the possibility of withholding remain intact.
src/content/model/statements/care-beyond.inferenceAndImpact: Retains S-004 conceptual and S-005 normative dependencies without duplicating S-022 transitively. ARG-004 remains defeasible and S-014 still requires a person-specific prospective judgment.

src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.proposition: Retained conditional application strategy delivers a selected input intended to test and act on a hypothesis through beneficial neuromotor alteration.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.qualifiers: When proceeding is warranted remains a necessary action condition; intended and training describe purpose, not actual learning, retention, adjustment, or success.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved strategy confidence is retained. The actual effect is separately asserted in S-011 and its perturbation explanation in S-028; application confirms neither.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.alignment: The new title identifies delivery plainly. Body and summary distinguish the act from organism response and retain withheld action and unspecified technique/dose requirements. No adjustment or success is assumed to have occurred.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.inferenceAndImpact: Practical S-011 edge becomes S-028 to track the intentional mechanism; S-014 still determines selection and warrant. ARG-003 remains a defeasible rationale for reassessment, not a reason for repeated inputs.

src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.proposition: New definition of the deliberately applied neurobiomechanical stimulus by intended neuromotor influence.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.qualifiers: Deliberately and intended identify delivery and purpose, not actual reorganization. An input with no response remains an input.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.evidenceSeparation: Not-applicable confidence identifies terminology, with no validated technique, dose, learning, or effect claim. Training remains intended use.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.alignment: Title, summary, body, and practical application language keep the delivered stimulus distinct from S-024 organism response and S-025 success. All relevant delivered inputs can therefore be counted.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.inferenceAndImpact: Conceptual S-008 defines the neuromotor domain and S-024 depends on this input meaning. The definition establishes neither S-011 occurrence nor reliable assessment/selection.

src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.proposition: Actual joint causal claim that some inputs cause reorganization that itself improves context-appropriate function. This remains empirical occurrence, not purpose or a success definition.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.qualifiers: Some is retained. Neuromotor scope, context, and timescale explicitly bound the functional comparison. The previous perturbation restriction moves to S-028, preserving the stronger mechanism commitment in the full account.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.evidenceSeparation: Confidence remains unresolved. No documented source establishes input causation plus qualifying improvement; general modifiability and sensory updating cannot supply the same-response overlap. Null tests must be sensitive to the specified conditions.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.alignment: Summary, body, and revision condition all require actual reorganization and comparative improvement. All inputs, adverse responses, no-reorganization/no-benefit cases, and uncertain outcomes remain in accounting. Single favorable surrogates do not count automatically.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.inferenceAndImpact: Replaces S-005/S-010 edges with conceptual S-021/S-024. ARG-007 uses this exact joint empirical premise; S-027 depends on it empirically, and S-028 adds a mechanism for its qualifying effects. Broader transfer and principal mediation remain additional burdens in S-012/S-013.

src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.proposition: New separate empirical chiropractic perturbation mechanism for some of the same input-caused reorganizations that improve function.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.qualifiers: Some retains actual mechanism-and-effect occurrence. Specified neuromotor scope/context/timescale and established motor strategies preserve a bounded effect rather than all-input or whole-person benefit.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence and absence of claim-specific evidence remain explicit. General S-010 capacity or motor-learning studies cannot establish this chiropractic mechanism; salience cannot be defined retrospectively by success.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.alignment: Canonical wording preserves the original S-011 perturbation commitment as a stronger independent claim. Its explanation and revision condition distinguish failure of mechanism from failure of the effect itself.
src/content/model/statements/chiropracti.inferenceAndImpact: Empirical dependencies on S-010 and S-011 track general mechanism and the joint outcome. S-015 translates this mechanism into intentional application; S-011 does not depend on S-028, allowing an effect to survive a failed explanation.

src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.proposition: Retained framework requirement to distinguish claim kinds, validity, premise truth, and evidential strength.
src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.qualifiers: Must expresses an adopted methodological requirement, not a claim that all current empirical propositions are true.
src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.evidenceSeparation: Definitions do not establish existence; adoption is explicitly independent of empirical confidence. S-026 is evaluative and S-027 mixed in accordance with these distinctions.
src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.alignment: The explanation of validity, soundness, and epistemic strength remains applicable to ARG-006 and ARG-007. No schema or template promotes their empirical premises to confirmed truth.
src/content/model/statements/claim-disci.inferenceAndImpact: Its methodological S-001 dependency and participation in ARG-001 remain appropriate. The benefit deductions were assessed from exact premises before source support.

src/content/model/statements/context-app.proposition: New definition of contextual suitability and comparative improvement, independent of the evaluative label benefit.
src/content/model/statements/context-app.qualifiers: Actual state/environment/demands, identified comparison, specified functional scope/timescale, and relevant gains/losses constrain a claim. Scope can be local but cannot conceal known losses or support a broader conclusion.
src/content/model/statements/context-app.evidenceSeparation: Not-applicable confidence identifies a definition, not a validated empirical comparison method. Goals and competing demands require explicit practical judgments; no unique optimum or global score is asserted.
src/content/model/statements/context-app.alignment: Statement, summary, and body reject circular benefit definitions, single-metric success, ideal posture, symmetry, low tone, and universal model accuracy. The improved-metric/lost-stability counterexample remains unresolved unless relevant tradeoffs support better fit.
src/content/model/statements/context-app.inferenceAndImpact: Conceptually informs S-022, S-009, S-011, S-012, and S-025 without biological existence assumptions. The benefit arguments reuse its improvement predicate consistently; costs/risks beyond the comparison remain in the intervention judgment.

src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.proposition: Retained method of exposing premises, scope, modality, and inference before appraising empirical support.
src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.qualifiers: Where the Model proposes a following relation limits its application; should expresses method. Empirical revisability prevents the order from becoming a license to defend a predetermined conclusion.
src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.evidenceSeparation: The actual-effect claim was preserved while its confidence remained unresolved. The bounded source check followed construction of the value, definition, and effect routes.
src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.alignment: Summary and explanation preserve capacity, existential, and action-condition distinctions. They do not equate the two deductive labels with evidential certainty.
src/content/model/statements/explicit-re.inferenceAndImpact: Methodological dependencies on S-001 and S-002 remain distinct from ARG-001. S-011 retains the joint causal overlap missing from a chain of independent some or can propositions.

src/content/model/statements/functional-.proposition: New explicit value commitment that any qualifying improvement provides functional benefit in the same scope, context, and timescale.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.qualifiers: Any universally evaluates qualifying changes, not all inputs. Specified scope and interval prevent inference to broader or enduring benefit. Intrinsic value does not require a symptom or health payoff.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.evidenceSeparation: Not-applicable confidence separates adopted value from empirical measurement and biological explanation. The body explicitly permits evaluative criticism without treating empirical confidence as acceptance.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.alignment: Canonical criterion, summary, and explanation agree on improvement being valuable in itself. Known losses remain visible and the value of a functional gain does not settle whether intervention costs and risks are justified.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.inferenceAndImpact: Conceptual S-021 supplies meaning. Normative downstream uses in S-005/S-026/S-027 and premise roles in ARG-004/ARG-006/ARG-007 are explicit; the value is no longer silently borrowed from S-005 professional purpose.

src/content/model/statements/functional-.proposition: Unchanged framework claim of open-ended human functional potential, understood across circumstances and purposes.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.qualifiers: Open-ended excludes neither biological constraints nor a locally best feasible response; it does not assert an actionable opportunity at each moment.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.evidenceSeparation: Not-applicable confidence remains appropriate to this framing. ARG-005 offers a defeasible rationale rather than empirical confirmation or universal benefit.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.alignment: Statement, summary, boundary, and revision condition retain the Stage 2 meaning. Its explanation does not make S-021 or the value premise depend on a guarantee of improvement.
src/content/model/statements/functional-.inferenceAndImpact: S-005 and S-006 retain conceptual revision dependencies. ARG-004 adds S-022 but remains defeasible; neither benefit deduction uses S-004 as an unnecessary premise.

src/content/model/statements/information.proposition: Retained empirical sensory-information and prior-experience account of estimates used in human neural regulation.
src/content/model/statements/information.qualifiers: Available is neither complete nor optimal. The explanation does not require one global internal model or the same computation in every neural process.
src/content/model/statements/information.evidenceSeparation: Retained Stage 2 Kording/Wolpert task example and limitations concern behavior, not direct neural implementation or chiropractic effects. Confidence remains unresolved across the wider statement.
src/content/model/statements/information.alignment: Exact sentence, summary, explanation, and whatWouldChange distinguish estimates from observed motor output. S-021 expressly avoids equating better function with globally greater model accuracy.
src/content/model/statements/information.inferenceAndImpact: Conceptual impact on S-020 and premise participation in ARG-005 remain appropriate. No benefit deduction uses this evidence as a substitute for actual input-caused improvement.

src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.proposition: Unchanged empirical central integrative neural role in human function within interacting bodily and environmental systems.
src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.qualifiers: Central is integrative, not exclusive or supreme; the statement does not attribute nervous systems to every organism.
src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence and lack of a documented claim-specific appraisal are retained. The new definitions and benefit deductions supply no evidence for this empirical role.
src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.alignment: Summary, body, and revision condition maintain function-specific scope and distinguish S-017 organismic maintenance from the additional human neural premise.
src/content/model/statements/nervous-sys.inferenceAndImpact: Remains an independent premise of defeasible ARG-005 and an empirical revision input to S-013. Neural integration alone cannot establish principal chiropractic mediation.

src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.proposition: Retained empirical claim of broader chiropractic influence principally through nervous-system-mediated change.
src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.qualifiers: Principally asserts primacy without exclusivity or an effect from every input. Occurrence, mediation, primacy, and pathways remain distinguishable.
src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence and absence of a documented claim-specific appraisal are unchanged. Neither S-011 nor a successful adjustment supplies missing broader mediation evidence.
src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.alignment: The revised explanation matches S-012 broader-improvement scope without making every neurally mediated effect beneficial. Temporal ordering and correlated responses remain insufficient for the mechanism.
src/content/model/statements/neural-medi.inferenceAndImpact: Empirical S-007 and S-011 dependencies remain with updated response note; the S-012 see-also pair stays independent. Local benefit without broader transfer or principal mediation is compatible with the benefit deductions, not evidence for S-013.

src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.proposition: Empirical capacity for modifying some limiting strategies to improve context-appropriate function; constraint and beneficial opportunity remain different concepts.
src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.qualifiers: Some and can are preserved. Unspecified overall is deliberately bounded to a neuromotor scope and timescale, not weakened to mere intention; relevant functional gains and losses remain part of improvement.
src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.evidenceSeparation: Franklin primary paper and bibliographic record support task-specific adaptation in five healthy adults. Notes do not validate the constraint construct, the full contextual comparison, assessment, or chiropractic response. Confidence remains unresolved.
src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.alignment: Summary, constraint/subluxation explanation, and revision conditions now use S-021 comparison. Functional losses remain in that judgment; costs and risks also inform the separate intervention decision. No diagnosis or displacement is required by the working construct.
src/content/model/statements/neuromotor-.inferenceAndImpact: Conceptual S-005 edge is replaced by S-021; S-008 is retained. ARG-002 still cannot infer this person has a detectable opportunity or that an effective input matches it from population-level modifiability.

src/content/model/statements/organismic-.proposition: Unchanged empirical organismic maintenance and adaptation of functional organization.
src/content/model/statements/organismic-.qualifiers: Actively concerns biological participation, not consciousness, infallibility, or guaranteed progress. Organisms can maintain without improving.
src/content/model/statements/organismic-.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved appraisal across organisms/processes remains explicit. Replacing the ordinary word adjustment with adaptation changes no empirical content or source attribution.
src/content/model/statements/organismic-.alignment: Definition of functional organization, boundary, and revision condition are compatible with S-021 contextual comparison. No human neural premise or chiropractic outcome is imported into this organism-wide claim.
src/content/model/statements/organismic-.inferenceAndImpact: ARG-005 still uses this independent biological premise defeasibly. S-021 defines a concept without depending on empirical truth that living organisms actively maintain it; no benefit-to-foundation cycle is added.

src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.proposition: Retained framework division of connected philosophical, scientific, and practical responsibilities; no chiropractic effect is asserted by the triad.
src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.qualifiers: Best-supported and contextually govern practical application, while revision remains possible. These qualifications are unchanged.
src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.evidenceSeparation: Not-applicable confidence concerns a framework commitment. Historical Stephenson and Strauss notes remain provenance, not evidence of modern effects or authority for the new value criterion.
src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.alignment: Canonical sentence, explanation, acknowledgment, Model naming, and authorship remain consistent. The unchanged public templates state adoption separately from support and show no editorial status.
src/content/model/statements/philosophy-.inferenceAndImpact: S-002 and S-003 retain methodological dependencies; ARG-001 remains defeasible. The new definitions and value deductions fit this division without imposing domain order on inference.

src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.proposition: Professional-purpose value remains: facilitating context-appropriate improvement is a legitimate chiropractic aim. It is no longer treated as the canonical benefit criterion.
src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.qualifiers: Legitimate aim is retained and not made exclusive. Replacing net-positive with context-appropriate deliberately separates functional improvement from worthwhile intervention; the latter remains required in practice.
src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.evidenceSeparation: S-022 independently adopts the value formerly carried only in this explanation. Neither value is supplied by biology, and no effect confidence is increased.
src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.alignment: Statement, revised summary, and body consistently distinguish intrinsic functional value, professional purpose, actual occurrence, and person-specific justification. Costs, risks, burdens, alternatives, and uncertainty remain explicit.
src/content/model/statements/purpose.md.inferenceAndImpact: Retains S-004 conceptual impact and adds S-022 normative impact. ARG-004 uses the actual professional-purpose proposition alongside the separate value premise; S-009/S-011/S-012 now use S-021 for outcome meaning.

src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.proposition: Retained reassessment strategy checks the hypothesis and informs stopping, revision, or a justified subsequent input.
src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.qualifiers: Following input triggers comparison only after delivery; when justified continues to govern further action. Unchanged or uncertain observations do not require repetition.
src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved confidence and unvalidated methods remain explicit. Before-and-after findings alone cannot establish causation, durability, broader benefit, or mechanism.
src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.alignment: New explanation separately assesses reorganization, improvement, and cause and preserves uncertain classification. A favorable metric with relevant losses does not settle improvement; even established functional benefit need not make further input worthwhile.
src/content/model/statements/reassessmen.inferenceAndImpact: Practical S-014/S-015 remain and conceptual S-025 is added for outcome interpretation. ARG-003 retains its two practical premises and defeasibility; no reverse dependency cycle represents the next clinical assessment.

src/content/model/statements/regulatory-.proposition: Retained empirical limits on neural regulation from incomplete information, biological constraints, and competing demands.
src/content/model/statements/regulatory-.qualifiers: These limits are separate, not all causes of sensory uncertainty and not a guarantee of poor fit or an available better response.
src/content/model/statements/regulatory-.evidenceSeparation: Combined claim remains unresolved with no documented full appraisal. Limited sensory/task examples do not establish all components or their interactions.
src/content/model/statements/regulatory-.alignment: Statement, explanation, and revision condition distinguish estimation limits, response feasibility, and tradeoffs. S-021 accommodates competing functions without defining every conflict as remediable.
src/content/model/statements/regulatory-.inferenceAndImpact: ARG-005 remains defeasible and no dependency is added just to connect the reading progression. S-009 still bears independent modifiability burden and S-011 independent input/effect overlap.

src/content/model/statements/salient-per.proposition: Retained empirical capacity of salient neurobiomechanical perturbation to prompt reevaluation and reorganization.
src/content/model/statements/salient-per.qualifiers: Sufficiently salient defines a proposed condition and can a capacity; neither guarantees change. Salience must be specified independently of successful response.
src/content/model/statements/salient-per.evidenceSeparation: Unresolved appraisal is retained. No general motor-learning study is newly claimed to establish these salience conditions or chiropractic effects.
src/content/model/statements/salient-per.alignment: The only body change routes chiropractic mechanism instantiation to S-028 and distinguishes input/response definitions. Neutral, transient, and harmful reorganization remain possible.
src/content/model/statements/salient-per.inferenceAndImpact: Retains conceptual S-008 and see-also S-020. Its empirical mechanism dependency now belongs to S-028, permitting S-011 effect claims to survive failure of this explanation.

src/content/model/statements/sensory-upd.proposition: Retained empirical estimate updating and capacity for sensory information to lead to strategy reorganization.
src/content/model/statements/sensory-upd.qualifiers: Can lead describes capacity, not inevitable novelty response. Updating an estimate and changing coordination remain distinguishable.
src/content/model/statements/sensory-upd.evidenceSeparation: Stage 2 Shadmehr/Mussa-Ivaldi task example and its sensory/practice/mechanical confounds remain bounded. It supplies no chiropractic success, durable benefit, or broader-health evidence; confidence remains unresolved.
src/content/model/statements/sensory-upd.alignment: Definition cross-references, title, summary, current evidence, and revision condition distinguish passive motion, estimate updating, and altered coordination. The new response definition does not make ordinary sensory updating an adjustment.
src/content/model/statements/sensory-upd.inferenceAndImpact: Retains conceptual S-018/S-008 dependencies, see-also S-010, and defeasible ARG-005 participation. S-010 salience and S-028 chiropractic instantiation remain separate mechanisms.

src/content/model/statements/state-depen.proposition: Canonical empirical statement of context-sensitive neuromotor function and limited or poorly suited strategies in some circumstances is retained.
src/content/model/statements/state-depen.qualifiers: Some circumstances limits the poor-fit claim. Variation alone does not imply limitation, modifiability, benefit, or an input indication.
src/content/model/statements/state-depen.evidenceSeparation: Checked Carpenter indexed abstract and Gribble primary paper against the limited task notes. Stiffness and co-contraction examples support context sensitivity, not a clinical detection method or chiropractic success; confidence stays unresolved.
src/content/model/statements/state-depen.alignment: Definitions of motor strategy and neuromotor function remain intact. New S-021 explanation rejects lower tone or greater symmetry as universal improvement criteria; input terminology replaces ambiguous procedural adjustment uses.
src/content/model/statements/state-depen.inferenceAndImpact: S-009, S-010, and S-020 retain conceptual dependence on this domain. S-023 adds conceptual input-target meaning. These edges and ARG-005 participation do not turn adaptation or variation into benefit.

src/content/model/statements/success-and.proposition: New evaluative conclusion: every successful adjustment provides the functional benefit in its specified neuromotor scope, context, and timescale.
src/content/model/statements/success-and.qualifiers: Every ranges over qualifying successes, not all adjustments or inputs. It remains compatible with no successful adjustments occurring.
src/content/model/statements/success-and.evidenceSeparation: Value classification and not-applicable confidence separate this conditional evaluation from empirical occurrence. ARG-006 does not validate a test or raise confidence in S-011.
src/content/model/statements/success-and.alignment: Statement, summary, and body agree that this is analytic given the value premise. No-reorganization and no-benefit cases do not falsify this conditional conclusion, but remain relevant to input effectiveness.
src/content/model/statements/success-and.inferenceAndImpact: Conceptual S-025 and normative S-022 dependencies independently express revision impact. ARG-006 also uses S-024 to identify the qualifying response as a change; no transitive dependency is copied merely from argument membership.

src/content/model/statements/successful-.proposition: New successful-adjustment definition combines actual input-caused reorganization with context-appropriate improvement in a specified neuromotor comparison.
src/content/model/statements/successful-.qualifiers: Successful is conditional on meeting the criterion, not merely a favorable observation. Specified scope, context, and timescale bound what can be called success.
src/content/model/statements/successful-.evidenceSeparation: Not-applicable confidence is appropriate to a definition; S-011 separately asserts actual qualifying occurrence. Outcome uncertainty remains unresolved rather than automatically passed or failed.
src/content/model/statements/successful-.alignment: The independent S-021 criterion includes competing gains and losses. No broader transfer, neural primacy, retention beyond the interval, or intervention-worth judgment is smuggled into success. All delivered inputs remain accounted for.
src/content/model/statements/successful-.inferenceAndImpact: Conceptual S-024 and S-021 define response and improvement. ARG-006 entails S-026 evaluatively but supplies no existence evidence. S-016 depends on this interpretation criterion without claiming assessment can establish it reliably.
